name: Pomodoro Focus & Break Engine
summary: Pure reducer state machine controlling Focus, Short Break, Long Break, and Completed phases with custom minute durations, cycle counts, and wall-clock deadline reconciliation.
userBenefit: Provides a predictable, calm structure for work sessions with automated phase progression and zero drift during system sleep.
limitations: Does not support seconds-level custom durations (integer minutes only).

name: Deep Focus Audio & Soundscapes
summary: Offline CC BY ambient audio library combined with isolated local HTTP provider host for Spotify and YouTube streaming auto-bound to focus timer state.
userBenefit: Immerses the user in custom or built-in focus audio that automatically starts and pauses with work sessions.
limitations: Spotify official iframe API lacks volume and fade-out controls. YouTube metadata requires cloud worker API key. No Spotify user account library import.

name: Workspace Task & Daily Flow
summary: Local task list with modal creation, editing, current-task selection, multi-select re-ordering, and automatic midnight reset with daily routine retention.
userBenefit: Keeps work items directly tied to the active timer session and clears yesterday's clutter automatically.
limitations: Sub-tasks or nested task hierarchies are not supported.

name: Desktop Distraction Blocker
summary: Multi-tier Windows blocker utilizing taskkill for processes, hosts file modification for DNS redirection, and PowerShell window title matching to close browser tabs.
userBenefit: Enforces local focus by closing distracting apps and websites automatically when a focus session starts.
limitations: Requires Windows Administrator elevation (UAC prompt). DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) in browsers can bypass hosts file blocking if tab is not closed.

name: Google Calendar OAuth Task Import
summary: Secure OAuth integration with Cloudflare Worker broker that lists user calendars, queries events in RFC3339 time ranges, and imports them as 1-way Toki tasks with 32-bit FNV-1a deduplication.
userBenefit: Converts scheduled calendar events into actionable focus tasks without manual data entry.
limitations: 1-way import only (no write-back event creation or editing in Google Calendar). Google Tasks API is not implemented.

name: Notion OAuth 2-Way Task Sync
summary: OAuth integration with 4-concurrency recursive block traversal for task import, and a persistent write-back queue that updates Notion page status and checkbox blocks when completed in Toki.
userBenefit: Syncs tasks bidirectionally with Notion databases and Mental Palace pages.
limitations: Requires exact column property names ('Status', 'Done', 'Completed At', 'Focus Minutes') on custom Notion databases.

name: Todoist OAuth Task Import
summary: OAuth 2.0 integration allowing users to browse Todoist projects and import uncompleted tasks with priority, label, and due date metadata.
userBenefit: Brings Todoist project tasks straight into the local focus workspace.
limitations: 1-way import only (scope requested is read-only 'data:read'; no write-back task completion).

name: Local Focus Analytics & History
summary: Local analytics engine calculating daily focus time, session deduplication, current/best streak tracking, and interactive monthly activity calendar.
userBenefit: Helps track long-term productivity patterns and maintain focus streaks without external tracking.
limitations: Data is stored locally in Electron store; clearing local app data removes history unless backed up.

name: System Tray & Background Operation
summary: Windows system tray integration allowing Toki to run silently in the background when the main window is closed, maintaining active blocker and timer operations.
userBenefit: Keeps distraction blocking active without occupying space on the taskbar.
limitations: Windows system tray menu options are minimal (Show Application, Quit).

name: Local-First Zero-Telemetry Security Architecture
summary: Local-first data model with zero user tracking/analytics, OS-backed safeStorage DPAPI encryption for local installation secrets, AES-256-GCM cloud token encryption, and strict renderer process isolation.
userBenefit: Guarantees complete personal privacy; personal focus data and tasks never leave the device.
limitations: Integrations require connection to Cloudflare Worker broker.

name: Visual Bonsai Growth Companion
summary: SVG visual growth indicator that advances through 5 intra-session stages (seed to flourished) and 5 global evolution levels as focus sessions accumulate.
userBenefit: Provides subtle, non-intrusive visual encouragement during work blocks.
limitations: Visual customisation of the Bonsai species is not supported.

name: Windows System Startup / Autostart
summary: Option to launch Toki automatically when Windows boots.
userBenefit: Would start focus protections on system boot.
limitations: Not implemented. No calls to app.setLoginItemSettings() or registry autorun exist.
